# Feature: Mimic orb — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #36 (Mimic orb) from Enemies and Bots before it is used in real levels. Effect: turns into a patroller up close. Unique: a pickup that was an enemy in disguise. Useful: makes the player read orbs before grabbing them. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** turns into a patroller up close.

**So that** makes the player read orbs before grabbing them.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Mimic orb for the first time in its teaching room (mech-36-mimic-orb-room). Teaching moment: First room: three orbs in a row, of which the middle one is a mimic. A player who collects in the order they meet them reveals it at arm's length and is reset, which teaches that an orb is read before it is taken. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Identical to an orb until you come within one tile, when it reveals and starts a small two-to-three tile patrol, lethal on touch
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Before it reveals, stepping on it collects nothing

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Mimic orb's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-36-mimic-orb-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/enemies-and-bots.yml mechanic #36.
